Mira was unable to attend because she was ill.

关键词：PREVENTED

Mira ____ because she was ill.

### 1

I only realised how valuable the notebook was after I had thrown it away.

关键词：DAWN

It ____ how valuable the notebook was until I had thrown it away.

### 2

The repeated interruptions made it impossible for Farah to concentrate.

关键词：PREVENTED

Farah ____ the repeated interruptions.

### 3

I am certain that the committee did not approve that proposal.

关键词：HAVE

The committee ____ that proposal.

### 4

Although the guide was concise, it covered every safety procedure.

关键词：AS

Concise ____, it covered every safety procedure.

### 5

The documentary was so compelling that I watched it twice in one evening.

关键词：SUCH

It ____ that I watched it twice in one evening.

### 6

The builder said he was not responsible for damaging the fence.

关键词：DENIED

The builder ____ the fence.
